explore-coils.title: Two coils
explore-coils.prompt: Two 12 mH coils in series. Rewire them so the total is half of one coil.
explore-coils.success: Parallel: 6 mH, half of one coil. In series they made 24 mH, twice one coil.

explore-caps.title: Two capacitors
explore-caps.prompt: Two 24 µF capacitors in series. Rewire them to get twice the capacitance of one.
hints: Capacitors do the opposite of coils.
explore-caps.success: Parallel: 48 µF. Capacitors add in parallel; in series they made 12 µF, half of one.
